en: Fixed `claude -p` exiting 0 when a full disk or quota lost its transcript or \~/.claude.json writes; it now prints an error and, in text and json output, exits 1. Full NFS exports may be missed
zh: 修复了磁盘已满或配额耗尽导致 transcript 或 \~/.claude.json 写入失败时，`claude -p` 仍以 0 退出的问题；现在会打印错误，并在 text 和 json 输出中以 1 退出。完整的 NFS 导出可能仍会被漏检
